title: Growth Capital and Post-Investment Value Creation | GOP
description: GOP helps promoter-led businesses build the investment case, pitch to mid-market PE and VC investors, and deliver the value-creation plan after investment.

nodes.name: Growth Capital and Post-Investment Value Creation
nodes.serviceType: Growth Capital and Post-Investment Value Creation
nodes.description: GOP does not invest its own money. It helps a promoter-led business build the case for capital, prepare the pitch deck and investor information, take the pitch to suitable mid-market PE and VC investors and work through the raise. After investment, GOP helps leadership turn the investment thesis into a plan and deliver it.

audience.audienceType: Promoter-led businesses, primarily INR 150-500 crore revenue, and their investors
